description: This Java source file defines an abstract exception class 'ModuleMustStartException' used in the OpenMRS framework to signal startup issues with modules that are required to start. It extends RuntimeException and provides a constructor accepting a message.

classes.name: ModuleMustStartException
classes.description: An abstract class representing exceptions thrown when required modules fail to start during OpenMRS initialization.

methods.name: ModuleMustStartException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a specified detail message.
